fig1_poisson_pmf.svg: Poisson pmf P(X=k)=e^{-lambda} lambda^k / k! for lambda=1, 4, 10 (bars, from poisson_pmf). The single parameter lambda is both mean and variance, so the distribution shifts right and broadens as lambda increases.
fig2_poisson_limit.svg: Binomial pmfs Bin(n, lambda/n) for n=8, 20, 80 (markers) closing on the Poisson(4) pmf (bars) as n grows with np=lambda=4 fixed. The legend shows the max gap from poisson_limit_of_binomial shrinking toward zero.
